clarity_of_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly articulates its research objectives in the abstract and introduction. The PICO elements are well-defined: Population (PD and DLB patients), Intervention (neuroanatomical normative modeling applied to T1w-MRI), Comparator (high vs low visual performers in PD; PD vs DLB; conventional GLM analysis), and Outcomes (total outlier count, dissimilarity patterns, associations with cognition). The study explicitly states three research aims: (a) investigating differences in total outlier count between groups, (b) comparing patterns of dissimilarity, and (c) evaluating correlations with cognitive severity.
clarity_of_research_objectives.supporting_text: We aimed to quantify patterns of neurodegenerative dissimilarity in participants with PD and DLB and evaluate the potential clinical relevance of total outlier count by testing its association with key clinical measures in PD and DLB... Here, we a) investigated differences in total outlier count between high and poor visual performers with PD; and between PD and DLB; and compared these to conventional cortical thickness analyses; b) compared patterns of dissimilarity between PD participants with high versus poor visual function; and between PD and DLB participants, and c) evaluated whether total outlier count correlated with cognitive severity in PD and DLB.
